we have developed a method for computing traces of fermionic propagator, which has the following features: i) it does not require a priori knowledge of the number of particles, ii) the method is variational, iii) the method is non-perturbative, iv) the method is applicable to both fermionic and bosonic systems, v) the method is equally applicable to the description of propagators with or without projective operators.
we can calculate traces of propagators in a systematic way, which is a major step forward compared to the standard perturbative approaches, which are not systematic.

the method can be applied to the calculation of fermionic propagator traces.
the method is applicable to any number of particles and to any number of good quantum numbers, provided that the number of particles is even.
